summary.title: A Tactical Guide to Managing Up: 30 Tips from the Smartest People We Know
summary.one_liner: A roundup of tactics from startup leaders on managing up, covering alignment on success, communication style, making requests, and handling feedback with your manager.
keywords: netflix don't seek to please your boss
takeaways: Confirm with your manager what success means for you and for their team, and revisit it as goals change.
Learn how your manager listens and processes information, then shape your message to fit it (e.g., lead with the proposed solution).
Communicate early and often, and introduce big ideas in pieces rather than all at once.
Keep requests separate from general updates, and bring prepared options and tradeoffs when asking for a decision.
Accept positive and constructive feedback well, and push back on your manager productively rather than just trying to please them.
summary.summary: This First Round Review article gathers 30 tips from startup leaders (such as Varun Srinivasan, Julie Zhuo, and Betty Liao) on managing up, organized into seven sections: assumptions, communication delivery, getting a yes, feedback, 1:1s, sharing impact, and building trust. Each tip is a short, practical tactic, often illustrated with a personal anecdote from the contributor. The page text provided is cut off partway through tip 19, so the final sections on trust and rapport are not fully covered here.
